observations: Photos 0 and 1 show an industrial flatbed lockstitch sewing machine head mounted on a white table with a metal stand.
Badge on the arm reads EMEL in photos 0 and 1; a small plate on the arm front reads EM 8500 in both photos.
A motor hangs under the table top and a red and green OFF/ON switch box is fitted to the table edge (photo 0).
An EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR carton sits beside the stand (photos 0 and 1), so the motor is a clutch motor, not a servo.
Thread stand with spool pins fitted on the table (photo 1), red foot pedal pad, bobbins and a red tray of small parts on the table.
Paint and table top look clean with little visible wear; no stitching, fabric or running machine is shown.
No manual is visible in either photo. Photos carry a Jiji watermark.

identity.kind: industrial straight stitch sewing machine with table and clutch motor
read_from: photo 0 arm badge and front plate
photo 1 arm badge and front plate
photo 0 and photo 1 motor carton reading CLUTCH MOTOR

claims.evidence: Condition looks light-use in photos 0 and 1, but age cannot be shown by a photo; no receipt shown.
No clip of the machine running or stitching; photos show it static.
Photos 0 and 1 show an EMEL badge and EMEL clutch motor carton, not a Japanese make; no origin plate is shown. Priced as the Emel read off the arm.
No clip with sound of the motor running.
Thread stand, pedal pad, bobbins and a parts tray are visible, but no laid-out shot of the full accessory set.
No manual visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be shown in a photo.

risks.risk: Machine or motor does not run or stitch properly (hook timing, feed, clutch wear).
risks.proof: One continuous clip: switch on at the OFF/ON box, press the pedal, sew a few lines on fabric, then show the stitches close up from both sides.

risks.risk: Motor is noisy, overheating or the clutch slips.
risks.proof: Clip with sound of the motor running at idle and full pedal for half a minute.
One photo of all accessories and the manual laid out together beside the machine.
risks.if_unproven: as machine, table and motor only, no accessories or manual

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage under the table top or to the head underside (oil leaks, cracked parts).
risks.proof: Photo with the head tilted back showing the underside and the motor mount.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine switched on and sewing on fabric, with sound, then the stitches close up.
Photo of all accessories and the original manual laid out together.
Photo with the head tilted back showing the underside and oil pan.
Close-up photo of any serial or model plate on the head and the motor.
response.reason: The badge and plate read Emel EM 8500 industrial straight stitch machine with clutch motor and table, so it can be priced at worst case as not working until a running and sewing clip is sent. The Japanese-made claim is not supported by the Emel branding and does not raise the price.
